long_biography.plain_text:
Minerva Marine grew from six managed tankers into a large private shipping group under Andreas J. Martinos. Tanker management, especially Aframax operations, gave the company its early identity; later expansion reached product carriers, larger crude carriers and dry cargo. The business developed alongside separate shipping companies led by his brothers.

Martinos paired expansion with an operating culture built around technical management, seafarer training and safety systems. Minerva added dry-cargo management through Minerva Dry in 2020, creating another specialist arm without abandoning its tanker base. His industry role extended beyond the company through service on the boards of the Union of Greek Shipowners and the Standard Club.
